svg.title: till-01 Walk-in order and live queue (Counter Staff iPad till)
svg.desc: Low-fidelity iPad till in landscape at Market Hall at 12:21: product tiles by category with a sold-out tile, the walk-in order being built (Chicken Wrap without Pickled chili with Feta, Sparkling lemonade, pickup 12:24, cash and card buttons for EUR 11.90), and the live queue with a late till order, a web order, an app order with Deliver and an order locked on another till. Numbered callouts 1 to 10.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Tile shade = category color in the Admin Panel (gray here).
Tap the time to place unpaid.
Tint = who took it (teal = AH). Badge = state.
Hold a row 0.6 s to cancel (reason required).
